_note: Phase 10 (docs/series-and-channels.md): Science & Engineering's own continuity assets. No real prerecorded station-id/bumper media exists for this channel yet, so "station_ids"/"filler" are deliberately left empty -- this project's own instructions are explicit that nonexistent media must never be invented or referenced. Every gap this channel has is therefore filled by the dynamic "science-up-next" card alone (see channels/continuity-card.js), which needs no video asset at all. Real station IDs can be added here later (e.g. once produced via OpenArt or any other tool) without any other change -- ContinuityFiller already prefers them over the card whenever one fits.
